errors.message: That article code is already used
errors.description: An article code identifies one article within a clinic and cannot be reused.

errors.message: That location name is already used
errors.description: Two locations of the same clinic cannot share a name.
A lot code identifies one batch of one article and cannot be recorded twice.

errors.message: Name the lot for this article
errors.description: An article that tracks lots requires a lot on every movement, so expiry stays answerable.

errors.message: This article does not track lots
errors.description: Lots can only be recorded for an article created with lot tracking enabled.
The movement would leave a negative quantity. Only an adjustment may, and it must say why.

errors.message: A movement of zero changes nothing
errors.description: Every ledger line must move a non-zero quantity.

errors.message: This movement needs a positive quantity
errors.description: Only an adjustment carries its own sign; every other reason knows which way stock went.
Stock cannot move into or out of a location the clinic has retired.
Archiving a location that holds material would drop that material out of every total while it is still on a shelf.

errors.message: A transfer needs two different locations
errors.description: The origin and the destination of a transfer cannot be the same location.

errors.message: An implantable device must track lots
errors.description: A trace without a batch traces nothing: enable lot tracking on the article before recording implants of it.
